plays.description: On fourth-and-three with two minutes left, Daniels throws incomplete. Captions mention both Diggs and Burks and garble the covering defender's name.
Commentary retrospectively indicates SF threw on second down; target and outcome omitted.
McCaffrey waits for a punt and is hit immediately; commentary says the play was blown dead for delay of game.

Under pressure on second-and-10, throws away from inside the pocket with no eligible receiver in the area. Intentional grounding brings loss of down and a 10-second runoff.
The game ends with Daniels sacked against a three-man rush. Commentary names three safeties back: Davis, Malik Mustapha and Brown. Sack-credit names are garbled.

offense_strengths: Generated explosive passes to McLaurin for 27 yards and Burks for 30 yards.
Late passing production included Diggs' one-handed sideline catch, Williams' 23-yard reception and White's nine-yard angle-route touchdown.
Daniels delivered the one-yard touchdown to Diggs despite Mustapha's pressure.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Evans receptions of 24 and 54 yards and Kittle's 35-yard reception.
Allowed an 11-yard touchdown pass to Kittle and two one-yard left-guard touchdowns to McCaffrey.
Evans gained 16 yards on a route described as looping around Sonny Styles against zone coverage.

offense_strengths: Purdy connected with Evans and Kittle for multiple explosive gains; commentary explicitly credited protection on the 54-yard Evans play and the 35-yard Kittle play.
McCaffrey contributed underneath receptions and two one-yard left-guard touchdowns; commentary praised left-side blocking on the first rushing score.
Purdy converted an early fourth down by scrambling and later pushed forward on another fourth down with Juszczyk assisting.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Washington's 27-yard McLaurin reception, 23-yard Williams reception and 30-yard Burks reception.
Allowed short touchdown passes to Diggs and White during Washington's comeback.
Davis' illegal-contact penalty against man coverage awarded Washington a first down on fourth-and-eight.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were viewed and no commands were run. Fragmentary plays are included with unknown results rather than reconstructed. The supplied DB is a selected-play list, so NO DB MATCH does not establish that a play did not occur. The unidentified second-and-10 Washington completion and third-and-two SF completion cannot confidently be assigned to the DB's Okonkwo and Watkins gains. Kickoff returns listed only in the DB are excluded because the captions do not identify them. Formation and personnel remain unknown because commentary does not explicitly identify them; DB shotgun labels were not used for those fields. Coverage is recorded only when explicitly described, without inferring a numbered coverage. Named DB tacklers are labeled as tacklers, not assumed to have lost coverage. Null yards indicate unavailable or unconfirmed official yardage; the nullified McNichols run was described as 31 yards but was not a valid touchdown. The disputed punt recovery, several penalties, intended receivers and sack participants cannot be resolved. Scoring distances and results use the supplied authoritative DB where a clear match exists.
